Technical and design decisions:
- Use existing Spring XD module and stream architecture; refactor BaseDefinition to lazily resolve modules from registry rather than storing list.
- For reliable HDFS writes, use HDFS DataStream API with explicit flush and close (or hflush/sync) and acknowledge only after commit; integrate with existing sink module.
- For partition override, allow modules to specify a PartitionFunction bean or class name in module configuration, and wire it into the message bus producer.
- For multiple topic-partitions, use a single Kafka consumer group subscribing to multiple topics and funneling records into a single internal queue for processing.
- For DSL parser, implement a separate validation parser that maintains a global stream registry context so Flo UI can parse streams independently; reuse ANTLR grammar if present, add semantic validation for module/option values.
- For single container deployment, design colocated module deployment using same ApplicationContext or shared ClassLoader, with direct in-JVM channels between modules.
- For ConfigurableConversionService tuples, implement custom serialization/deserialization that carries conversion service configuration, or use a global registry to restore non-default service after deserialization.
- For JMX benchmarking, use a standalone test harness with configurable JMX flags and measure throughput/latency.
